title: Rules.
bodyText: The board and the board of regents of the University of Hawaii may adopt necessary rules under chapter 91 to administer and implement sections 302A-430 and 302A-431, including the adoption of safety guidelines and safety inspection procedures of facilities where students are placed. The department and the University of Hawaii shall inspect each facility annually before the placement of students with these facilities.
bodyHtml: §302A-431  Rules.  The board and the board of regents of the University of Hawaii may adopt necessary rules under chapter 91 to administer and implement sections 302A-430 and 302A-431, including the adoption of safety guidelines and safety inspection procedures of facilities where students are placed.  The department and the University of Hawaii shall inspect each facility annually before the placement of students with these facilities. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2; am L 1997, c 344, §4; am L 2012, c 133, §8; am L 2022, c 224, §2; am L 2024, c 167, §2]
